title: Perceptual Weight Space Programming for Diffusion Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.18690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models for image super-resolution can recover scene content while producing distracting artifacts or unbalanced colors. We study whether a large language model (LLM) can improve perceptual quality by editing a small subset of existing U-Net weights without a clean reference image. The proposed framework provides the editor with architecture code, selected weights, activation summaries, and sampling previews. It permits up to 1,020 candidate trials while limiting accepted changes to three layers and fewer than 0.1\% of model parameters. The evaluation protocol uses ResShift, SinSR, and SUPIR and compares GPT-6 Astra with a specified Qwen3-VL model under matched access. Feedback metrics guide editing, while separate quality metrics and blinded human comparisons evaluate the final weights. translated_title: 面向扩散模型超分辨率的感知权重空间编程
translated_abstract: 用于图像超分辨率的扩散模型在恢复场景内容的同时，可能产生干扰性伪影或颜色失衡。我们研究大语言模型（LLM）能否在无干净参考图像的情况下，通过编辑现有U-Net权重中的一个极小子集来提升感知质量。所提出的框架为编辑器提供架构代码、选定的权重、激活摘要以及采样预览。该框架允许最多1,020次候选试验，同时将最终采纳的修改限制在三层以内，且不超过模型参数的0.1%。评估协议采用ResShift、SinSR和SUPIR三种方法，并在同等访问权限条件下将GPT-6 Astra与指定的Qwen3-VL模型进行比较。反馈指标用于指导编辑过程，而独立的质量指标和盲测人类对比则用于评估最终的权重。我们还报告了一项已实际执行的颜色校准实验，该实验使用真实照片和两个小型残差网络。该实验表明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个框架，让大语言模型在无干净参考图像的条件下，仅通过修改扩散超分辨率模型U-Net中三层内不到0.1%的参数，即可消除伪影、校正颜色失衡并显著提升感知质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework that enables a large language model to improve the perceptual quality of diffusion-based super-resolution by editing fewer than 0.1% of U-Net parameters across only three layers, without requiring any clean reference image.
